data.name: Block1_Title
data.value: Ultimate Freedom: One-Click Solo Time Tracking

data.name: Block1_Description
data.value: For individual developers and freelancers, the approval procedure is completely disabled. You can start the timer, edit, or delete any of your entries at any moment. Maximum speed and productivity with zero overhead.

data.name: Block1_Item1_Desc
data.value: Start and stop tracking immediately with one click. Switch tasks seamlessly without mandatory forms or friction.

data.name: Block1_Item2_Desc
data.value: Adjust time entries, descriptions, and projects at any time. Fix typos or delete accidental records instantly.

data.name: Block1_Item3_Desc
data.value: Tracked hours immediately translate into your personal earned totals and reports without awaiting any manager approvals.

data.name: Block2_Description
data.value: In Team Mode, timesheet approvals are enabled by default. Tracked hours automatically follow a secure review workflow, locking approved data and protecting your financial reports from retroactive changes.

data.name: Block2_Item1_Desc
data.value: Work in progress belongs exclusively to the developer. Managers only see time entries once they are formally submitted for the week.

data.name: Block2_Item2_Desc
data.value: Review team members' weekly timesheets side-by-side with task context, billable tags, and total summaries without context switching.

data.name: Block2_Item3_Desc
data.value: Managers provide clear feedback when rejecting an entry, allowing developers to adjust the record and resubmit quickly.

data.name: Block3_Title
data.value: Safe Accounting: Auto-Locking of Approved Hours

data.name: Block3_Description
data.value: Once a manager approves a team member's hours, they transition to Approved status and are strictly locked against modifications on the backend. Zero accidental retroactive edits and complete financial consistency.

data.name: Block3_Item1_Desc
data.value: Approved records cannot be altered, moved, or deleted by anyone, protecting your accounting from accidental revisions.

data.name: Block3_Item2_Desc
data.value: In Team Mode, approval rules are permanently enforced to maintain historical integrity and eliminate retroactive revisions.

data.name: Block3_Item3_Desc
data.value: Approved entries feed directly into subcontractor payout balances and client invoices with unquestionable accuracy.
